text.p: Italian police on Thursday detained 102 people trying to enter Italy illegally on a fishing boat on a small island between Sicily and Libya.
Police said three members of the crew were arrested after the boat, which was flying a Tunisian flag, arrived at Lampedusa island.
The crew will face charges of attempting to smuggle illegal immigrants into Italy.
Late on Wednesday, coastguards intercepted another boat with 59 people which was attempting to reach Lampedusa from Tunisia, the nearest African country to Italy.
Police said all the immigrants will be transported to Sicily from where they will be sent home within 15 days.
Lampedusa island has been a regular target for groups trying to smuggle immigrants into Italy over the past few years.
Many of the illegal immigrants who have arrived in recent years come from the Indian sub-continent.
After the latest arrivals Lampedusa mayor Salvatore Martello called on the Italian government to do more to stem the flow.
"The government should intervene to defend, including out at sea, the frontiers of our territory," Martello said.
